parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this {{object}} instance. This parameter is based on ''ifAdminStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}.

parameters.name: UseBulkDataProfile
parameters.description: Enables or disables the ability to use a bulk data profile for this communication channel

parameters.name: BulkDataProfile
parameters.description: {{reference|a {{object|###.BulkData.Profile}} object that is used to represent communication channel}}

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The {{datatype}} of the LMAP component that is the target of this communication channel.

parameters.name: TargetPublicCredential
parameters.description: {{reference|a {{object|###.Security.Certificate}} object that is used to identify the target of this channel}}

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: {{reference|an interface object used to restrict the data transmitted or received using this channel to a specific interface}} If the value of this parameter is {{empty}} the data that is transmitted or received using this channel is able to use any available interface.

object.description: This object represents the properties communication channel used to establish communication between a measurement agent and other elements of the LMAP framework (e.g., measurement controller, measurement collector). The value of the {{param|Name}} parameter used for conveying information is defined as an option in the Task's or scheduled Task's option parameter. When this object uses the BulkData capability, a {{object|###.BulkData.Profile.{i}}} object instance referred to by this object.
